reviews.author: Jason

reviews.title: Does its job but measure first
reviews.comment: Installation is straightforward with diagrams. Temperature at idle is around 47C with a 9950x3d and 100% load is 81C. Noise level ranges from 38 db (idle) to 55 db (full load). As far as performance, it does the job very well for an air cooler at around 50-60 dollar range.  Be aware to measure the height clearance in your case and heights of ram because this cooler is relatively tall at 165 mm due to the display. Also ram heatsink or tall ram can push the intake fan out of the case; you can set the fan as exhaust but it will cost you 1-2 degrees C.

reviews.title: GREAT Air Cooler!
reviews.comment: Sits on a 9800X3D and it keeps the CPU at about 65C at load (it's 45C as I write this).  It helps that it's winter and the room is 15C.  It will hit about 22-25 in this room during the summer, so I'm guessing it won't go over 80C.  Be sure to change the software to read "CPU Package" and not "CPU".  CPU temps were about 10C too low. CPU Package is more accurate.
